Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Vihaan - 11 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Anita - 38 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Zoya - 10 years, friend
Look: green salwar-kurta, short hair
4. Ishaan - 9 years, friend
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
5. Sharda - 66 years, grandmother
Look: white saree, glasses

Places

1. The park - green grass, swings, benches
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The park - Day

[Vihaan stands in the park. Anita, Ishaan and Sharda stand near him.]

Sharda: "Vihaan, what's the plan today?"

[Vihaan does push-ups.]

Anita (softly): "How beautiful!"

[Vihaan does yoga on a mat.]

Anita: "Really?"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Vihaan stands in the living room. Anita stands near him.]

Anita: "What a nice place."

[Vihaan drinks a glass of water.]

Vihaan (surprised): "Really?"

[Vihaan serves hot rotis to Mother.]

Anita (happily): "Let's see."

Scene 3: The courtyard - Day

[Vihaan stands in the courtyard. Anita and Ishaan stand near him.]

Vihaan: "So, here we are!"

[The sun sets behind the trees.]

Vihaan: "And then?"

[Night falls and the stars come out.]

Anita: "This is amazing!"

[Dark clouds gather in the sky.]

Vihaan: "How beautiful!"

[A rainbow appears in the sky.]

Vihaan: "Oh wow!"

Scene 4: The courtyard - Day

[It is raining heavily. Vihaan stands in the courtyard. Anita and Ishaan stand near him.]

Vihaan: "What a nice place."

[Vihaan opens his umbrella.]

Vihaan: "Oh wow!"

[Vihaan puts on his raincoat.]

Ishaan: "Oh wow!"

[The rain stops.]

Ishaan (surprised): "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
